title: Anthropic Opus 5.5 Leads AI Business Spend With 34% Share
summary:
OpenAI is capturing a larger share of the corporate AI market at the expense of Anthropic, according to the latest Ramp AI Index. Despite this trend, Anthropic's Opus 5.5 model currently drives 34% of total business AI spending, and high-cost models such as Opus, Fable, Sol, and Astra collectively command the majority of industry expenditure.

Overall growth in AI spending has slowed among the largest users, with the top 1% of firms spending $9,568 per employee in September, down 3.1% from a July peak of $9,873. Ramp reports that total spending is stagnating because falling token prices are offsetting rising usage volumes, while the median business across the index spends only $16 per employee per month.
